Keep track of the latest news about our solar system and the universe.
NASA’s Future Astronauts : The space agency is recruiting its next class of space travelers for missions to low-Earth orbit and the moon.
Could Alien Life Thrive in Acid? : Best known for dissolving bodies in bathtubs, sulfuric acid has the potential to be the elixir of life on other worlds.
A Meteorite From Mars: Reddish rocks found in the Sahara four years ago turned out to be not of this world: They are pieces of Mars dating back 4.1 billion years .
A New Dwarf Planet (Probably): The object, spotted beyond Pluto and known for now as 2026 ED138, is one of the first discoveries by the new Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile.
Gaze at the Cosmic Dawn: A new simulation offers a highly immersive look at what happened during the first couple of billion years following the Big Bang .
